mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_order (order_no, warehouse_id, status, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{warehouseId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO outbound_order_item (order_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, sku_id, quantity FROM outbound_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, order_id, sku_id, quantity FROM outbound_order_item WHERE order_id IN #{orderId} ORDER BY order_id, id
SELECT * FROM outbound_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_order SET status = 'RESERVED', reserved_by = #{reservedBy}, reserved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE outbound_order SET status = 'CREATED', released_by = #{releasedBy}, released_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE outbound_order SET status = 'COMPLETED', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE outbound_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_by = #{cancelledBy}, cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED'
